title: CI-side LeftBlock scan for commits made without the hook
description: Local hooks don't cover commits made with --no-verify, in clones where the hook was never installed, or before install (Prospectus #54 added a real address on 2026-10-20). Ship a reusable GitHub Action or workflow snippet that runs the shipped ruleset over a PR's commits (gitleaks git --log-opts base..head) with the same allow file and overrides, so repos get a server-side backstop. (Prospectus feedback, 2026-10-21)

comments.author: home
comments.text: Status 2026-10-23: not started. Next step: design a reusable GitHub Action or workflow snippet running the shipped ruleset over a PR's commits with the staged allow file.
